annotations.title: Set the path of a form or shop

description: Put a form (alias instead of /f/<slug>) or a shop at a path under the address of its brand. The old path redirects. For a form, path null removes the alias; a shop always needs a path. check_path first.

id.description: The form's or shop's id from get_address_plan.

kind.description: What should live at the path: a form or a shop.

path.description: The new path without slashes — or null (form only).

name: set_path
title: Set the path of a form or shop
